title: The `nail search` help text has typos
body:
clap builds `nail search --help` from the doc comments in nail/src/args.rs. A survey of `dev` on 2026-11-02 found these; I confirmed the first two in the source:

- `-a` and `-f` write `ɓ`, a b with a hook, where they mean β.
- `-S` reads "the number of taret sequences".
- The `--seed-mode` text writes `prog-f` without the `--`, with uneven indentation.
- `--mmseqs-s` describes the scale as "1.0 faster; 4.0 fast; 7.5 sensitive" but defaults to 10 without saying so.

## Proposal

Fix each.
